# Mahadev Marine Exports Pvt. Ltd. — Full AI-readable company profile

Mahadev Marine Exports Pvt. Ltd. is a seafood sourcing, procurement and buyer representation company from Andhra Pradesh, India. The company connects international seafood buyers with suitable Indian seafood processing facilities and coordinates sourcing, procurement, production communication, quality assurance, packaging, export documentation, reefer logistics and shipment follow-up.

## Buyer value proposition
International seafood procurement requires more than competitive pricing. Buyers need consistent specifications, transparent communication, technical knowledge, reliable processor matching and controlled shipment execution. Mahadev Marine helps overseas importers simplify the procurement process and reduce sourcing risk.

## Experience
The procurement team has more than 20 years of combined seafood raw-material sourcing and procurement experience. The quality coordination team has more than 20 years of combined seafood quality-management and processing experience. The export documentation team has more than 10 years of combined experience coordinating documents required for international shipments.

## Services
Seafood sourcing, procurement management, buyer representation in India, processor identification, supplier evaluation, production coordination, quality assurance coordination, packaging coordination, private-label support, export documentation coordination, shipping and logistics coordination, reefer container planning, shipment monitoring, product specification matching, export consultation, market intelligence, supplier communication and international buyer support.

## Procurement process
1. Understand the buyer requirement: species, product form, count size, glaze, packing, certifications, destination and commercial terms.
2. Match suitable processors capable of meeting the requirement.
3. Coordinate quotations, negotiations, production planning, specifications and shipment schedules.
4. Coordinate quality inspections, packaging verification and specification compliance.
5. Coordinate export documentation, reefer container planning, shipping schedules and shipment follow-up.

## Buyer-specific production and quality updates
Associated buyers can receive controlled updates for their own order only. Update scope may include raw-material intake, production stage, grading, freezing, glazing, packing, net weight, quality-control status, documentation and shipment readiness. Frequency, evidence and access are defined by the commercial agreement.

## Seafood products
Vannamei Shrimp (Penaeus vannamei), Black Tiger Shrimp (Penaeus monodon), HOSO, HLSO, EZ Peel, PDTO, PD, PUD, butterfly cut shrimp, cooked PD, cooked PDTO, shrimp skewers, customised value-added shrimp, frozen fish fillets and Yellowfin Tuna loins.

## Additional divisions
The agro division includes rice, millets, green chilli, dried red chilli, dried red chilli powder, whole black pepper, Arabica coffee beans and Robusta coffee beans. The shrimp byproduct division includes chitin flakes.

## Key Export Destinations & Regional Sourcing
- Export Destinations: United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain), East Asia (Japan, China, South Korea, Taiwan), and Australia.
- Sourcing Hubs Across India: Andhra Pradesh (Kakinada, Bhimavaram, Visakhapatnam), Gujarat (Veraval, Porbandar, Mangrol), Kerala (Kochi, Kollam), Odisha (Bhubaneswar, Paradeep), and West Bengal (Kolkata).
